- [ ] New/changed environment variables are documented in
      `.env.example` and `docs/ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLES.md`
- [ ] Database schema changes include an Alembic migration
- [ ] I updated relevant docs (`README.md`, `docs/`) if behavior changed
